targeted_attempts.diagnosis: Both journeys failed scoped axe target-size checks for21px nested evidence summaries before screenshot capture. The control sizing was corrected; original failures remain retained.
One journey passed; the authoring journey failed at an accessible-name selector containing help text. The test selector was corrected without weakening product assertions.

One journey passed; authoring/repair failed the phone participation-history document-width assertion. Absolute screen-reader UUID labels escaped static table scroll containers. Adding position:relative to the table scroll container fixed the observed overflow without hiding content or weakening assertions.

Both targeted journeys passed after the CSS correction. This earlier pass used the source before the separate graph asset copier correction; the final full run below qualifies the later rebuilt source.

implementation_agent.method: Viewed every final full-run original PNG through view_image at original detail; no crop, compositing, retouching, regeneration or other image edit. Checked visible layout, legibility, RTL presentation and control states. Each archived/source PNG hash was verified.

verified: Sixteen distinct browser journeys passed once each, with no failures, skips, retries or flaky outcomes.

New graph-operation journeys exercise positive minimum failure, joint endpoint assignment and edge creation, exact draft round-trip, explicit consent, immutable receipt/history, same-pair forward repair, stale-preview recovery, competing execution and current-scope/tenant denial.

All16 final migration screenshots were actually inspected by the implementation agent, and five were separately inspected by the root agent.
